_comment: The SUBTLER vacuity fixture, and the one that matters more. The fetch
worked — there are pull requests and issues here — but every one of them
is closed and falls outside the window. Naive code computes a full
document of zeroes from this and calls it a quiet fortnight. It is not:
it is a window that selected nothing, which is what a wrong -now, a wrong
-window-days or a paginator that stopped early looks like.
